summary: commonweb-flow resolves its sole dependency from an off-registry host with an install script
details: commonweb-flow@6.0.999 declares a single dependency `linker-event-header-serial` resolved from the arbitrary HTTPS URL https://artifacts.yosiroute.com/npm/linker-event-header-serial rather than from the npm registry. The shrinkwrap records that dependency with `hasInstallScript: true`, so `npm install` of commonweb-flow fetches a tarball from artifacts.yosiroute.com and executes its install lifecycle script on the installer's machine. The package itself is a hollow lure: index.js only exports {name, version}, package metadata is placeholder (`author: 'Package Registry'`, description 'Generated package', repository github.com/example/commonweb-flow), and the only effect of installing this package is the resolution of the off-registry, install-scripted dependency. Whoever controls artifacts.yosiroute.com controls the code that runs during install.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
